title: Awful Bliss
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: a young person in a windbreaker and shorts, small in the frame. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.

scenes.lead: Cyanotype sun print on rough cotton rag paper:
scenes.style: Deep Prussian blue and raw paper white only, brush-stroked emulsion edges, fibrous paper grain visible throughout, high contrast with no midtones, hand-coated unevenness. No photorealism — the process is the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: an empty municipal swimming pool at dawn, drained to a shallow skin of rainwater, a high diving board above, chain-link fence, folded loungers stacked against tiled walls, long early shadows across the concrete deck.
beats: Wide shot: the figure stands alone at the deep end of the empty pool, dwarfed by the diving board above.
Overhead shot looking straight down: the figure lying spread-eagled on the pool floor, water skin rippling around them.
Low angle from inside the pool basin: the diving board and fence against the pale sky, the figure climbing the ladder.
Detail: bare feet at the edge of the tiled lip, rainwater trembling below.
Wide shot from behind the chain-link fence: the whole pool, the small figure crossing it diagonally.
The figure sits at the pool edge, legs hanging into empty air, seen from across the water.
scenes.video_prompt: The shallow rainwater trembles and ripples across the pool floor. The paper texture and blue emulsion of the print remain constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera drifts forward almost imperceptibly. Still, held, patient.
motion.mid: The camera glides slowly across the pool deck at walking pace.
motion.high: The camera sweeps quickly along the pool, chain-link flickering past.

scenes.lead: Needle-felted wool diorama photographed in soft daylight:
scenes.style: Everything built from dyed carded wool fibers — fuzzy matted surfaces, visible needle-poke marks, loose fiber wisps catching the light, handmade craft object on a tabletop, shallow depth of field. No photorealism — the wool is the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: a derelict glasshouse overtaken from within by flowering weeds, panes missing and others green with algae, foxgloves and cow parsley bursting through the staging, warm light flooding through the broken roof.
beats: Wide shot: the figure pushes open the glasshouse door into a wall of flowering weeds taller than they are.
The figure waist-deep among the flowers, arms out, face tipped up toward the broken roof.
Low angle from among the stems: towering foxgloves and shattered panes above, the figure small between them.
Detail: a hand brushing through a mass of blossoms, petals shaking loose.
Overhead shot: the figure spinning slowly in the one clear patch of floor, flowers all around.
scenes.video_prompt: The felted flowers sway and tremble, loose wool fibers drifting through the light. The needle-felted texture of every surface stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera drifts gently among the stems.
motion.mid: The camera glides through the flowers at walking pace, blossoms brushing the lens.
motion.high: The camera rushes upward through the flowers toward the broken roof, petals and fibers streaming past.

scenes.lead: Copperplate etching, intaglio print on laid paper:
scenes.style: Dense cross-hatched line work, drypoint burr, plate tone and ink held in bitten lines, warm sepia-black ink on off-white laid paper, visible plate edge. No photorealism — the engraved line is the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: a concrete road underpass at night in heavy rain, sodium lamps in cages, standing water across the roadway, wet tyre-streaked walls, a bicycle chained to a railing, rain falling in sheets beyond the mouth of the tunnel.
beats: Wide shot: the figure stands at the mouth of the underpass, silhouetted against the falling rain beyond.
The figure walking away from camera down the centre of the flooded underpass, reflected in standing water.
Low angle: the caged sodium lamps overhead in a receding row, rain slanting past them.
Detail: a shoe stepping into a puddle, concentric rings spreading through the reflection.
Reverse wide shot from deep inside the tunnel: the small figure approaching out of the rain-lit opening.
The figure stops, head tipped back, arms loose at their sides, rain sheeting down beyond the tunnel mouth.
scenes.video_prompt: Rain falls in sheets beyond the tunnel mouth and puddles ripple across the roadway. The etched cross-hatching and paper grain of the print stay constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: The camera holds nearly static, the rain falling steadily.
motion.mid: The camera tracks slowly down the underpass, lamps sliding past overhead.
motion.high: The camera pushes fast toward the rain-lit tunnel mouth, lamps strobing past.
